prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a rear-end collision claim. Injury: wrist fracture. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1307; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following a rear-end collision at a signalized intersection. Insured vehicle struck claimant's vehicle from behind at low speed. Police report requested. Claimant reports immediate neck stiffness and a wrist injury from bracing against the steering wheel. Recorded statement taken from insured, who admits to looking down at a phone just before impact.

Entry 2: Claimant has retained counsel. All further contact to go through the attorney's office. Letter of representation received and logged. Medical authorization forms requested from counsel. Photos of both vehicles received from claimant's side, showing rear bumper damage on claimant's car and minor crush to insured's front end.

Entry 3: Medical records received from the treating urgent care clinic. Diagnosis confirmed as a fracture of the distal radius on the claimant's left wrist. Claimant has been referred to an orthopedic specialist and is scheduled for a follow-up consult. Treatment includes casting and a possible surgical referral pending reassessment. Liability accepted at fault level pending final review of the police report.

Entry 4: Adjuster spoke with claimant's attorney regarding a demand package. Counsel indicated the wrist injury will likely require physical therapy and may affect the claimant's work as a delivery driver. Requested wage loss documentation and itemized medical bills. Reserve reviewed and flagged for supervisor sign-off given the fracture and representation status.

Entry 5: Orthopedic records received. Follow-up notes indicate the fracture is healing, with a physical therapy plan in place for six weeks. Surgical intervention was not required at this time. Claimant's attorney confirmed the demand will be submitted after the next treatment review. File remains open. Next action: obtain final police report and confirm wage documentation from the claimant's employer.
